lines.zh: 我在枯焦森林里飘，树都不认得我
lines.en: I drift the Withered Forest; no tree knows me.

lines.zh: 我的脚不落地，落叶却会动
lines.en: My feet don't touch ground, yet leaves stir.

lines.zh: 我沿着枯树干走，数还剩多少圈
lines.en: I circle dead trunks, counting my remaining laps.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，我才知道自己还在
lines.en: Wind passes through me; that's how I know I remain.

lines.zh: 我走过的路，灰会比别处厚一点
lines.en: Ash lies thicker where I pass.

lines.zh: 我飘得很慢，怕用掉剩下的时间
lines.en: I drift slowly, sparing what time is left.

lines.zh: 枯枝在我身边弯，像在让路
lines.en: Dead branches bend aside as I near.

lines.zh: 我绕着旧营地转，那里没人了
lines.en: I circle the old camp; nobody's there.

lines.zh: 我的影子留在树皮上，人不在了
lines.en: My shadow stays on bark; the man is gone.

lines.zh: 每走一段，我就淡一点
lines.en: With every stretch, I thin a little.

lines.zh: 我踩着别人的脚印走，分不清是谁的
lines.en: I walk in old prints; I can't tell whose.

lines.zh: 森林很静，只有我的呼吸是假的
lines.en: The wood is silent; only my breathing is false.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，听自己还剩几下
lines.en: I hang still, hearing how many beats remain.

lines.zh: 一只乌鸦落在枯枝上，又飞走
lines.en: A crow lands on dead wood, then leaves.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己的名字了
lines.en: I can no longer recall my name.

lines.zh: 灰落在我肩上，穿过去了
lines.en: Ash falls through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会再来的约定
lines.en: I wait for a promise that won't come.

lines.zh: 树干上的刻痕，是我刻的还是别人的
lines.en: These bark marks: mine, or someone's?

lines.zh: 我数到第七下，风停了
lines.en: I count to seven; the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到树枝，凉了一下
lines.en: My fingers brush a branch; it chills.

lines.zh: 森林记得所有人，只不记得我
lines.en: The forest remembers everyone but me.

lines.zh: 我在这里坐了很久，其实坐不了
lines.en: I've sat here long; I can't sit.

lines.zh: 你身上有温度，我很久没见过了
lines.en: You carry warmth; I haven't seen it in ages.

lines.zh: 你走过枯林，脚步太响了
lines.en: You cross the dead wood too loudly.

lines.zh: 你能看见我吗，还是只看见雾
lines.en: Can you see me, or only mist?

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我想起活着
lines.en: That torch reminds me of being alive.

lines.zh: 我认得你身后那棵树，它先死的
lines.en: I know that tree behind you; it died first.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，我不用
lines.en: You blinked; I don't need to.

lines.zh: 你的影子完整，我的不全
lines.en: Your shadow is whole; mine isn't.

lines.zh: 你是不是也听见有人在叫你
lines.en: Do you also hear someone calling?

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一扇关着的门
lines.en: I look at you like a closed door.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，从前站过别人
lines.en: Someone else once stood where you stand.

lines.zh: 你的剑碰到我，凉了一下
lines.en: Your blade touches me; it goes cold.

lines.zh: 我散开一半，又聚回来
lines.en: Half of me scatters, then returns.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起怎么死的
lines.en: That reminds me how I died.

lines.zh: 我没有血，只有灰
lines.en: I have no blood, only ash.

lines.zh: 你打中了，但我本来就不实
lines.en: You hit; I was never solid.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓晃了晃，雾补上了
lines.en: My outline wavers; mist fills it.

lines.zh: 疼是会过去的，我早过去了
lines.en: Pain passes; I passed long ago.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我一角，时间没少
lines.en: You cut a corner off; no time lost.

lines.zh: 我往后退，退进了树干里
lines.en: I recoil into a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 这一剑很实在，可惜我不实在
lines.en: A solid blow; I'm not solid.

lines.zh: 你想用食物引我，我早不饿了
lines.en: Food as bait? I stopped being hungry.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我只看见热气
lines.en: You hold bread; I only see warmth.

lines.zh: 我想要的不是吃的，是时间
lines.en: I don't want food; I want time.

lines.zh: 那点火光让我想起灶台
lines.en: That little flame recalls a hearth.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，风会带走
lines.en: Leave it down; the wind takes it.

lines.zh: 我跟着那点热气走了半步
lines.en: I drift half a step toward the warmth.

lines.zh: 死人不上钩，只会跟着活人
lines.en: The dead take no bait; they follow the living.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就不跟了
lines.en: One step back and I stop following.

lines.zh: 食物在我手里会烂得很快
lines.en: Food rots fast in my hands.

lines.zh: 别喂我，我咽不下去
lines.en: Don't feed me; I can't swallow.

lines.zh: 你穿过我，打了个寒战
lines.en: You pass through me and shiver.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，你却退了一步
lines.en: I weigh nothing; you still step back.

lines.zh: 别挤，雾会被你撞散
lines.en: Careful; you scatter the mist.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的地方，凉了一片
lines.en: Where you bumped me, the air went cold.

lines.zh: 我让开了，其实我不用让
lines.en: I moved aside; I needn't have.

lines.zh: 你肩膀擦过我的脸，什么也没碰到
lines.en: Your shoulder grazes my face and nothing.

lines.zh: 枯叶被你踩响，我被吵醒了
lines.en: You crunch dead leaves; it wakes me.

lines.zh: 我靠近你，你的呼吸就白了
lines.en: I near you; your breath turns white.

lines.zh: 你撞进一团旧雾里，那就是我
lines.en: You walked into old mist; that was me.

lines.zh: 别在我旁边站太久，会冷
lines.en: Don't linger beside me; you'll chill.

lines.zh: 我已经死了，生不出什么
lines.en: I'm dead; nothing grows from me.

lines.zh: 你找两只亡魂配对，只会更冷
lines.en: Pair two spirits and it just gets colder.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣留在那场火里了
lines.en: My partner stayed in that fire.

lines.zh: 林子里的婚约，早就枯了
lines.en: The wood's old vows have long dried up.

lines.zh: 我不留后，我只留一阵风
lines.en: I leave no heirs, only a gust.

lines.zh: 别用骨头喂我，那是我朋友
lines.en: Don't offer bones; those are my friends.

lines.zh: 亡魂不结伴，我们各飘各的
lines.en: Spirits don't pair; we drift alone.

lines.zh: 我连影子都不完整，怎么成双
lines.en: My shadow's incomplete; how could I pair?

lines.zh: 你问这个，我笑不出来
lines.en: You ask that, and I can't laugh.

lines.zh: 等这片林子绿了，再说吧
lines.en: Ask again when this wood turns green.

lines.zh: 我拿不住东西，手指会穿过去
lines.en: I can't hold things; my fingers pass through.

lines.zh: 地上的骨头我不捡，那可能是谁
lines.en: I leave bones on the ground; they might be someone.

lines.zh: 你掉的，风会替你收好
lines.en: You dropped it; the wind will keep it.

lines.zh: 我试过一次，东西直接穿过手心
lines.en: I tried once; it fell through my palm.

lines.zh: 亡魂没有口袋，也没有份量
lines.en: Spirits have no pockets, and no weight.

lines.zh: 别让我递东西，我递不到
lines.en: Don't ask me to hand things over; I can't.

lines.zh: 我只捡得起一片落叶
lines.en: The only thing I can lift is a leaf.

lines.zh: 让它留在灰里，这里的东西别带走
lines.en: Leave it in the ash; nothing leaves here.

lines.zh: 弯腰这个动作，我早忘了
lines.en: I've long forgotten how to bend down.

lines.zh: 你要捡就快，天快黑了
lines.en: Pick it up quickly; dark is coming.

lines.zh: 你踏进枯林，我醒了
lines.en: You entered the dead wood; I woke.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰忽然立起来
lines.en: The ash on me stands upright.

lines.zh: 你不是这里的人，我要你留下
lines.en: You don't belong here; I want you to stay.

lines.zh: 我的时间不多，正好够你
lines.en: Little time left; enough for you.

lines.zh: 枯枝开始朝你那边弯
lines.en: Dead branches bend toward you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，太吵了
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat; too loud.

lines.zh: 这林子缺一个人陪着
lines.en: This wood lacks one companion.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块骨头，那是我朋友
lines.en: You crushed a bone; that was my friend.

lines.zh: 我把雾聚起来，挡住你的路
lines.en: I gather the mist to block your way.

lines.zh: 你逃的话，会跑进更深的枯林
lines.en: Flee, and you run deeper into dead wood.

lines.zh: 我要借你的热气，一会儿就好
lines.en: I'll borrow your warmth; just a moment.

lines.zh: 你身上的活气，我闻得到
lines.en: I can smell the life on you.

lines.zh: 别怕，我不会留下痕迹
lines.en: Don't fear; I leave no marks.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就走不掉了
lines.en: I count to three, and you can't leave.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，别装作没看见
lines.en: I have marked you, so do not pretend not to see me

lines.zh: 雾跟着你转，别回头看
lines.en: The mist follows you; don't look back.

lines.zh: 我在你左边，又在你右边
lines.en: I'm at your left, then your right.

lines.zh: 你跑得越快，枯林越长
lines.en: The faster you run, the longer the wood.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近，你自己会累
lines.en: I needn't close in; you'll tire.

lines.zh: 你的火把在抖，我看见了
lines.en: Your torch is shaking; I see it.

lines.zh: 我穿过一棵树，出现在你前面
lines.en: I cross a trunk and appear ahead.

lines.zh: 你听得见吗，有人在你背后叹气
lines.en: Hear that sigh behind you?

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是提前到
lines.en: I don't chase; I arrive first.

lines.zh: 你在原地打转，我已经转过三圈
lines.en: You circle once; I've circled three.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，雾就浓了
lines.en: Your breath breaks; the mist thickens.

lines.zh: 我把你的脚印盖住了
lines.en: I've covered your footprints.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，正好对着你
lines.en: You stop; I stop, facing you.

lines.zh: 别走那条路，尽头是我死的地方
lines.en: Not that path; its end is where I died.

lines.zh: 我快没时间了，所以更快了
lines.en: My time runs short; so I move faster.

lines.zh: 我的时间只够追这一个人
lines.en: My time is only enough to chase this one

lines.zh: 你听，枯林在替你数数
lines.en: Listen, the withered forest is counting for you

lines.zh: 我提前站在你要拐的弯上
lines.en: I stand ahead at the bend you will take

lines.zh: 灰在我脚边聚成一个圈
lines.en: Ash gathers into a ring at my feet

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你的甲，碰到骨头
lines.en: My hand passes your plate and touches bone.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是冷
lines.en: This blow is light; only cold.

lines.zh: 你没有伤口，却开始发白
lines.en: No wound, yet you pale.

lines.zh: 我把你的热气吸走一口
lines.en: I take one mouthful of your warmth.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进雾里，什么也没砍到
lines.en: Your blade cuts mist and finds nothing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你耳边，说了一句旧话
lines.en: I lean to your ear and speak an old word.

lines.zh: 你后退，雾替你让开又合上
lines.en: You retreat; mist parts, then closes.

lines.zh: 我抓你的手腕，五指透过去
lines.en: I grip your wrist; my fingers pass through.

lines.zh: 这一下带着枯林的味道
lines.en: This strike carries the dead wood's smell.

lines.zh: 你开始听见很多人在说话
lines.en: You begin to hear many voices.

lines.zh: 我不停手，我的时间不多了
lines.en: I don't stop; my time is short.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖先软，我扶着它
lines.en: Your knees buckle first; I hold them.

lines.zh: 我每打一下，自己就淡一分
lines.en: Each strike makes me fainter.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我终于不那么冷了
lines.en: When you fall, I'm less cold at last.

lines.zh: 我伸手，你的手指先凉了
lines.en: I reach out and your fingers chill first

lines.zh: 这一下没有声音，只有冷
lines.en: This blow makes no sound, only cold

lines.zh: 枯林里多了一阵风，我就来了
lines.en: A new wind stirs the dead wood; I come.

lines.zh: 我从一棵枯树的裂缝里飘出来
lines.en: I seep from a crack in a dead tree.

lines.zh: 灰先聚起来，形状后到
lines.en: Ash gathers first; the shape comes after.

lines.zh: 这片林子死的时候，我也跟着死了
lines.en: When this wood died, I died with it.

lines.zh: 我在旧营地的火堆边显形
lines.en: I form beside the old camp's cold hearth.

lines.zh: 时间开始倒数，我听见了
lines.en: The countdown starts; I hear it.

lines.zh: 树上挂着的布条动了，我在下面
lines.en: Cloth on the branch stirs; I'm beneath it.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，林子里没有别人
lines.en: I open my eyes; no one else in the wood.

lines.zh: 又是这一片枯树，我认得每一棵
lines.en: These dead trees again; I know each one.

lines.zh: 我从别处回来，没带回什么
lines.en: I return from elsewhere with nothing.

lines.zh: 雾散了一瞬，我站在中间
lines.en: The mist parts a moment; I stand within.

lines.zh: 他们说这片林子闹鬼，是我
lines.en: They say this wood is haunted; it's me.

lines.zh: 我飘起来，脚下的灰跟着浮
lines.en: I rise; ash floats up beneath me.

lines.zh: 我又被留在这里了，第几次
lines.en: Left here again; which time is this?

lines.zh: 火照得我发亮，也照得我更淡
lines.en: Fire lights me up and thins me out.

lines.zh: 我不会摔，只是散了一阵
lines.en: I can't fall, only scatter briefly.

lines.zh: 水让我想起下葬那天的雨
lines.en: Water recalls the rain on my burial day.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹散，我慢慢拼回来
lines.en: The blast scatters me; I reassemble slowly.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，带走一缕雾
lines.en: The arrow passes, taking a thread of mist.

lines.zh: 那道光想送我走，我还没准备好
lines.en: That light wants me gone; I'm not ready.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只缺时间
lines.en: I don't hunger; I lack time.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整片枯林，只有我一个影子
lines.en: Lightning lights the wood; I'm its only shadow.

lines.zh: 虚空很安静，比我记得的还安静
lines.en: The void is quiet, quieter than I recall.
